1.0: You are welcome if you have good intentions, but if not, please leave here quietly. I will not forgive anyone that disgraces this peaceful and beautiful garden.

yes.0: Looks as though you are here to speak to me. Listening to, and exchanging one another's thoughts is a great way to advance one's consciousness. Not to mention, a delightful experience. I, #bEliza#k welcome you.

npc.0: Don't be afraid of him. Unless you're disrespectful, you'll be fine. He should be beyond the fallen pillar in in Stairway to the Sky 2.

0.0: This is weird. Eliza clearly regained her senses, but I can still feel the furious aura. Several of them, in fact. It's like Eliza has split into multiple parts... But, that's not possible...
0.1: Since Eliza is calm now, maybe we should just talk to her. Originally, she had a very gentle manner. So, please ask her not to destroy Cloud Park any more. That's reasonable, right?

yes.0: Eliza is at... #bEliza's Shrine#k, naturally. It's beyond the fallen pillar in Stairway to the Sky II. Be respectful... The last thing we need now is to make her mad again.

no.0: Look, as long as you show your respect, he won't tear you to shreds.

QuestInfo.name: Eliza's Garden
QuestInfo.1: It seems like Eliza has calmed quite a bit. So much so, in fact, that Kriel the Fairy suggested you strike up a #bconversation with Eliza#k. You can meet Eliza at #bEliza's Shrine#k behind the fallen pillar in Stairway to the Sky II.
QuestInfo.2: Met #bEliza#k sitting gracefully inside Eliza's Garden. #bEliza#k showed no traces of anger, instead looking calm.
QuestInfo.0: Kriel the Fairy wishes to speak with you.
